# Vodafone Group announces Q1 FY27 Trading Update


Share


1 minute read


Vodafone has today announced its trading update for the first quarter of the 2027 financial year.


The full text of the results announcement is available from the download link below.


For further information, including the presentation to analysts and investors, please visit our Investor Relations website[https://www.vodafone.com/investors/performance-and-reports/results-and-presentations](https://www.vodafone.com/investors/performance-and-reports/results-and-presentations)
